summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) combined with retifanlimab, a PD-1 inhibitor, in people with recurrent IDH-mutant glioma. ATRA is taken by mouth at 45 mg/m2 per day in two divided doses on days 1 to 14 of each 28-day cycle, and retifanlimab is given by IV at 500 mg on day 1 of each cycle. Treatment continues until disease progression, unacceptable toxicity, or 2 years from the first dose, whichever comes first, and the main outcome is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa el ácido all-trans retinoico (ATRA) combinado con retifanlimab, un inhibidor de PD-1, en personas con glioma recurrente con mutación IDH. El ATRA se toma por vía oral a 45 mg/m2 al día, en dos dosis divididas, durante los días 1 a 14 de cada ciclo de 28 días, y el retifanlimab se administra por vía intravenosa a 500 mg el día 1 de cada ciclo. El tratamiento continúa hasta la progresión de la enfermedad, toxicidad inaceptable o 2 años desde la primera dosis, lo que ocurra primero, y el resultado principal no está indicado.
who_for: Progressive or recurrent astrocytoma or oligodendroglioma after at least one prior alkylating chemotherapy
Tumor has a known IDH1 or IDH2 mutation confirmed by DNA sequencing
Karnofsky performance status of 60 or higher
Measurable disease on MRI for those with contrast-enhancing tumor, or a surgical indication for surgical arms
not_for: Contrast-enhancing tumor in the brainstem or spinal cord
Immunosuppressive medicine other than steroids within 6 months of starting study drug
Active hepatitis B or C, or HIV on antiretroviral therapy
